sloka: ते तु धर्म आत्मना दृष्टा राक्षस इन्द्रेण राक्षसाः ।विभीषणेन तत्रस्था निगृहीता यदृच्चया ॥६-२९-२७॥।।
transliteration: te tu dharma ātmanā dṛṣṭā rākṣasa indreṇa rākṣasāḥ ।vibhīṣaṇena tatrasthā nigṛhītā yadṛccayā ॥6-29-27॥।।

translations.english: By chance Vibheeshana seized Saardula, the evil Rakshasa who was moving in that army.
